description: This is a source file defining classes for an XML-RPC library, including value handling, message parsing, server and client implementations, and error handling.

classes.name: IXR_Value
classes.description: Handles data types and XML serialization for XML-RPC values.

classes.name: IXR_Message
classes.description: Parses and represents XML-RPC messages, including method calls, responses, and faults.

classes.name: IXR_Server
classes.description: Implements an XML-RPC server capable of handling requests and dispatching methods.

classes.name: IXR_Request
classes.description: Creates XML-RPC request XML for a given method and parameters.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: Client for sending XML-RPC requests to a server and processing responses.

classes.name: IXR_Error
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC fault/error with code and message, and outputs fault XML.

classes.name: IXR_Date
classes.description: Handles ISO8601 date representations for XML-RPC.

classes.name: IXR_Base64
classes.description: Represents binary data for XML-RPC, providing XML serialization with base64 encoding.

classes.name: IXR_IntrospectionServer
classes.description: Extends IXR_Server to provide introspection capabilities like listing methods and signatures.

classes.name: IXR_ClientMulticall
classes.description: Extends IXR_Client to support multicall batch requests.
